$comment: attestRecoveryPreviewDelivery accepts optional callbackTimeoutMs as a POST-HOC synchronous callback classification: an integer from 0 through 60000 milliseconds, defaulting to 1000. It is not a pre-emptive interrupt and cannot abort a running callback; elapsed time is measured with a monotonic clock and evaluated only after the callback has already returned or thrown, so a synchronous callback that never returns is never classified and hangs the calling process. Timeout results expose only RP-CALLBACK-TIMEOUT and never timing details, callback errors, paths, or private values. Promise callbacks remain non-success.
